chapter_introduction: A nature poem that invites children to notice the colours and visual beauty of a rainbow.
lesson_1: Activate prior knowledge, preview the title and predict what the learner may encounter.
lesson_2: Read 'The Rainbow' carefully, identify key details and explain the meaning in your own words.
lesson_3: Practise vocabulary, comprehension, speaking and written response using evidence from the chapter.
lesson_4: Apply the chapter idea to a familiar real-life situation and review the learning objectives.
